changelog:
Initial release — provides command-line examples for interacting with Elasticsearch and Kibana via REST API using curl.

- Covers authentication, cluster health checks, searching (Query DSL), CRUD and bulk document operations, mappings, indexing, aggregations, and index management.
- Includes guidance for both traditional and serverless Elasticsearch environments, with notes on unsupported endpoints.
- Demonstrates common troubleshooting patterns and explains critical variable handling for curl authentication.
- Reference sections link to additional Query DSL and aggregation commands.
summary: Interact with Elasticsearch and Kibana via REST API using curl. Use when querying, indexing, managing indices, checking cluster health, writing aggregations,...
